name: Emirates

evidence.claim: Weighs cabin bags — 7 kg in economy.

allowances.note: Standard Economy; Brazil departures allow 10 kg, India adds 115 cm linear limit. Route exceptions require ticket confirmation.

research_scope: Standard adult cabin/personal allowances; checked allowances remain unresearched unless a sourced checked row is present.
audit_note: Read Economy and route exceptions. Standard Economy 7 kg; departures from Brazil allow 10 kg; India additionally limits total dimensions to 115 cm. No additional ordinary personal bag is promised in Economy. Shared-weight groups, linear constraints, aircraft and entitlement exceptions require further engine/publication review. Strictness and sizer measurements were not verified in this audit.
